description: This file defines a class for loading data from Google Sheets as documents, including methods for listing spreadsheets, fetching sheet data, and converting sheets to document format. It integrates with Google Drive and Sheets APIs, handles credentials, and supports document processing features like text splitting and metadata management.

classes.name: GoogleSheets_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a node for loading Google Sheets data as documents, with methods for listing spreadsheets, retrieving metadata, sheet data, and converting sheets into document format.

methods.name: listSpreadsheets
methods.description: Lists Google Sheets files from Google Drive using Drive API, filtering for spreadsheet mime type.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Main method to load data from specified Google Sheets, process sheets, apply text splitting and metadata, and return documents or concatenated text.

methods.name: getSpreadsheetMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a specific spreadsheet from Google Sheets API.

methods.name: getSheetData
methods.description: Retrieves data from a specific sheet range within a spreadsheet.

methods.name: convertSheetToDocument
methods.description: Converts sheet data into a document object with markdown table content and metadata.
